description: Environment setup - install dependencies and verify the project builds cleanly before making any code changes.
steps: Run `npm install` in /projects/sandbox/pulsiv_fe to install all dependencies
Run `npm run build` (which runs `tsc -b && vite build`) to verify baseline compiles without errors
If there are TypeScript errors, note them but do not fix unrelated issues - only note blockers that would affect the project module pages
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes successfully OR only has errors unrelated to the project module pages we will modify
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit code 0 or only unrelated errors
findings: npm install requires --legacy-peer-deps due to react-simple-maps@3.0.0 having peer dep conflict with React 19 (expects React 16/17/18). With that flag, all 782 packages install successfully. Build (tsc -b && vite build) passes cleanly with exit code 0 - no TypeScript errors, no Vite errors. All project module pages compile and bundle without issues. 2841 modules transformed, built in ~30s.
